name: Darshan Orna Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Darshan Orna Ltd is in the business of Gold & Silver Jewelry and Ornaments including Diamond Jewellery[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is a Wholesaler of Gold & Silver Jewelry and Ornaments. It is also in the trading business of silver and distributor of readymade gold & silver Jewelry & Ornaments. 
This comprises of Traditional Jewelry ~20%, ~40 % of Modern Jewelry and ~40 % of Indo‐Western Jewelry. 
The company sources its raw material from its 
 suppliers based in Gujarat

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.85% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -10.7%
